ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 9, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

Chief Coleman, Chair  Robert Gill, Commissioner
Andrea Eaton, Vice Chair  Jessica Gillette, Commissioner
Raul Añorve, Commissioner  Barbara A. Pollack, Commissioner
Lani De Benedictis, Commissioner

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments to
  CityClerk@longbeach.gov

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55968  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Ethics Commission meeting of
  Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-56042  Recommendation to review and discuss, and if appropriate, approve the transmittal
  of a report from the Ad Hoc Committee on Social Media and Campaign Activity to
  the Mayor and City Council, outlining recommendations for the Mayor and City
  Council to adopt a policy or approve an ordinance regarding the social media
  accounts and campaign activities of elected officials.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-56043  Recommendation to receive and file monthly update from the Ad Hoc Committee
  on Commission Responsibilities.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-56044  Recommendation to receive and file monthly update from the Ad Hoc Committee
  on Investigative Protocol.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-56045  Recommendation to receive and file monthly update from the Ad Hoc Committee
  on Community Outreach; and approve the community outreach presentation for
  neighborhood associations on the Office of Ethics and Transparency’s mission and

  Page 1 of 3
   ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 9, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

  the Commission’s jurisdiction and work.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-56046  Recommendation to grant approval to all Commissioners to contact Long Beach
  neighborhood associations on behalf of the Commission and request time at an
  upcoming neighborhood association meeting to share the community outreach
  presentation created by the Ad Hoc on Community Outreach.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-56047  Recommendation to discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming
  projects; and, if appropriate, take action to dissolve, create or reauthorize Ad Hoc
  Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  26-56048  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ethics Officer.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  26-56049  Recommendation to discuss potential agenda items for future Commission
  meetings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Ethics Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Phillip McGowan, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
